act.name: Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986
act.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
act.description: Central law prohibiting child employment and hazardous adolescent employment and providing enforcement and rehabilitation measures.

sections.title: Prohibition of employment of children in any occupation and process.
sections.text: Section 3 prohibits employment of children subject to the provision's limited exceptions; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Employment of children is prohibited across occupations and processes, subject to narrow statutory exceptions.
